intro: This chapter describes every command OOS Plus implements, grouped by subsystem. Commands marked **OOS** are extensions that the Rigol DHO800/DHO900 command set does not have. Commands not listed here are not supported and report error -113.
dialect: Rigol DHO800/DHO900 subset with OOS extensions

appendices.title: Standard Measurement Items
appendices.intro: Items for `:MEASure:ITEM?`, `:MEASure:ITEM` and `:MEASure:STATistic:ITEM` with one source. The long form or the short form (upper-case letters) is accepted; `:MEASure:STRip?` returns the upper-case long form. A missing result is `9.9E37`.

rows: Rise time between the lower and upper thresholds
Fall time between the upper and lower thresholds
Overshoot after a rising edge, relative to the amplitude
Preshoot before a rising edge, relative to the amplitude
Time spent outside the measurement levels (`:MEASure:OUTSide`)
Estimated unit interval of a data signal
Unit interval from a PLL clock recovery
RMS deviation of the waveform folded on its unit interval

appendices.title: Pair Measurement Items
appendices.intro: Items with two sources, `<A>,<B>`. For delay, phase and skew, A is the reference edge and B the second edge. For setup and hold, A is the data and B the clock or strobe, as on the measurement page. A clock edge counts only when the data changed within that edge’s own cycle, so data that is steady between strobe bursts adds no result.

rows: Delay from a rising edge of A to the next rising edge of B
Delay from a falling edge of A to the next falling edge of B
Delay from a rising edge of A to the next falling edge of B
Delay from a falling edge of A to the next rising edge of B
Phase between rising edges of A and B
Phase between falling edges of A and B
Phase from rising edges of A to falling edges of B
Phase from falling edges of A to rising edges of B
Skew between rising edges of A and B
Skew between falling edges of A and B
Skew from rising edges of A to falling edges of B
Skew from falling edges of A to rising edges of B
Setup time of data A before rising clock edges of B
Hold time of data A after rising clock edges of B
Number of rising clock edges that violate `:MEASure:TSETup` or `:MEASure:THOLd`
Setup time of data A before falling clock edges of B
Hold time of data A after falling clock edges of B
Setup time of data A before both edges of strobe B (DDR: A = DQ, B = DQS)
Hold time of data A after both edges of strobe B
Number of strobe edges (both) that violate `:MEASure:TSETup` or `:MEASure:THOLd`

appendices.title: Eye Figures
appendices.intro: Figures for `:EYE:ITEM?`. They come from the Eye analysis page as configured; a figure that is not available is `9.9E37`.

Mean level of a logic zero

TIE peak-to-peak after supply-induced jitter is removed

Periodic jitter after supply-induced jitter is removed

Total jitter at the configured BER
Eye width at the configured BER

appendices.title: Analysis Page Items
appendices.intro: Items accepted by the analysis-page queries. Units in parentheses.

rows: `VRMS` (V), `IRMS` (A), `REAL` (W), `APP` (VA), `REAC` (var), `PF` (ratio), `PHAS` (deg), `FREQ` (Hz), `CREST` (ratio (voltage crest factor)), `CRESTI` (ratio (current crest factor)), `EON` (J), `EOFF` (J), `ECOND` (J), `PAVG` (W), `DVDTR` (V/s), `DVDTF` (V/s), `DIDTR` (A/s), `DIDTF` (A/s), `RDSON` (ohm), `RIPPLE` (V pk-pk), `ACRMS` (V rms), `LINE` (V pk-pk at line freq), `LINER` (V rms at line freq), `SWITCH` (V pk-pk at switching freq), `SWRMS` (V rms at switching freq), `INRUSH` (A peak), `I2T` (A²s), `TON` (s), `TOFF` (s), `CIN` (F), `ROVER` (V (rail overshoot)), `RUNDER` (V), `RDC` (V), `RMAX` (s (rail turn-on))
Bandwidth from a step (at least 1000 samples)

appendices.title: Error Codes
appendices.intro: Messages placed in the error queue (`:SYSTem:ERRor?`). A failing query also returns the message as its reply.

rows: Header not recognised; also any query that produced no reply without queuing its own error; also invalid values for the setters (CHANnel DISPlay/SCALe/OFFSet/POSition/COUPling/BWLimit/PROBe/INVert, TRIGger NREJect/HOLDoff/SWEep/EDGE:LEVel/EDGE:SLOPe/EDGE:SOURce D-token, ACQuire:MDEPth set). Action queries like :RUN? :STOP? *CLS? *RST? also land here.

Unknown keyword inside a known subsystem (TIMebase, CURSor, DISPlay, MEASure:STATistic, MEASure gate, BUS<n>, BUS<n>:RS232, MATH<n>, HISTogram, MASK, DVM, COUNter, LA, REF, SIM, DECode:<node> (without leading colon), :SOURce:ARB). Note: invalid TIMebase SCALe/OFFSet values also end here as :TIMebase:<path>.
:MATH<n>:FILTer:W1/W2 set on an operator without that corner, or W1 >= W2.
`-221,"Operation pending; use raw TCP or HiSLIP for *OPC?"`
`*OPC?` sent through the HTTP/MCP interface, which cannot wait.
:MEASure:ITEM / :MEASure:STATistic:ITEM set for a standard item failed (reason "Measurement selection is full").
`-223,"Too much data; select a shorter waveform page"`
:WAVeform:DATA? page larger than 64 MiB worst case.

Invalid or out-of-range parameter. The message may add a detail: <arg>, "timebase", "below the lower threshold", "above the upper threshold", "mask is off", "no file", "unknown key <k>", "SSC mode", "SIM setting", "PRBS order", "<n> samples", loader/store error text.
TRIGger ...:SOURce[2] argument is not CHAN/R/REF (and not a logic line D0–D15).
Trigger source refers to an empty reference or a channel beyond the model.
:MEASure:ITEM set with more sources than the item takes.
`-224,"Source A and B are the same source" / "Measurement selection is full"`
Adding a pair measurement fails (pair failures use -224, standard-item failures use -223).
Cursor source not on the model / reference not loaded / manual SOURce2 different from A.
:BUS<n> RS232/IIC/SPI source not a model channel or loaded reference.
Queued at the start of the next command after a background SIM generation failed.
Details: "reference is empty" (REF VSCale/VOFFset/LABel/COLor/RESet), "source has no waveform" (:MASK:CREate), "no LA record" (:LA:POINts?/PREamble?/DATA?).
:MATH<n>:SOURce1/2 or FFT:SOURce names an empty reference.
:DECode:EVENts? / :BUS<n>:DATA? when decoding cannot run (while decoding is still running the reply is `BUSY` instead).
Any :SOURce command on a model without a generator.
`-241,"Hardware missing" no logic analyser port on the <model>`
Any :LA command on a model without logic-analyzer inputs.
More than 20 queued errors: the last slot is replaced (ESR bit 3).
Accumulated reply of one program message would exceed 64 MiB.
`-363,"Program message too large or too many commands"`
Program message longer than 4 MiB or more than 1024 commands.
`-363,"Input buffer overrun" rest of the line dropped`
Reply buffer already at 64 MiB before the next command.
A pending *OPC? whose operation was cancelled/re-armed; no '1' is sent and the remaining commands are discarded.
